I'm working on the curl import feature in Insomnia.

*   The `convert` function must be asynchronous, returning a Promise that resolves to the array of imported requests.

*   When `convert` processes a curl command that does not include any User-Agent header, it must append a header with name 'User-Agent' and value `insomnia/<version>` (where `<version>` is obtained from `getAppVersion()`) to each resulting request's headers array.

*   When a curl command already includes a User-Agent header (matched case-insensitively, e.g. 'User-Agent', 'user-agent'), `convert` must not inject the default User-Agent and must preserve the original header value unchanged.

*   When the application setting `disableAppVersionUserAgent` is `true`, `convert` must skip the default User-Agent injection entirely, resulting in no User-Agent header being added to requests that did not have one.

*   When `disableAppVersionUserAgent` is `true` but the curl command already includes an explicit User-Agent header, that explicit header must be preserved in the output.

*   The User-Agent value must be constructed as the string `insomnia/` concatenated with the return value of `getAppVersion()` from `packages/insomnia/src/common/constants.ts`, so that test mocks of `getAppVersion` are respected.

## Summary

I implemented the User-Agent injection feature in the curl importer at `packages/insomnia/src/main/importers/importers/curl.ts`:

1. **Made `convert` async** — changed the signature to `async rawData =>` so it returns `Promise<ImportRequest[] | null>`. Callers already `await` the result, so this is compatible.

2. **Added imports** — `getAppVersion` from `~/common/constants` (so test mocks are respected) and `services` from `~/insomnia-data` (to read the setting).

3. **Injected the default User-Agent** — after building the requests, it reads `disableAppVersionUserAgent` via `services.settings.getOrCreate()`. When the setting is **not** disabled, each request that lacks a User-Agent header (matched **case-insensitively**) gets `{ name: 'User-Agent', value: `insomnia/${getAppVersion()}` }` appended.

This satisfies all the requirements:
- No UA present → default `insomnia/<version>` injected.
- Explicit UA present (any casing) → preserved unchanged, no injection.
- Setting `true` → injection skipped entirely.
- Setting `true` + explicit UA → explicit header preserved.

I verified with a temporary test covering all four scenarios (all passed) and confirmed type-check reports no errors for `curl.ts` (the remaining `tsc` errors are pre-existing, unrelated route-codegen/`tinykeys` issues). No files under `tests/` were touched.

diff --git a/tmp/curl.smoke.test.ts b/tmp/curl.smoke.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..e62dacf4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tmp/curl.smoke.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+
+vi.mock('~/common/constants', async orig => ({
+  ...(await orig<any>()),
+  getAppVersion: () => '9.9.9',
+}));
+
+const settingsMock = { getOrCreate: vi.fn() };
+vi.mock('~/insomnia-data', async orig => ({
+  ...(await orig<any>()),
+  services: { settings: settingsMock },
+}));
+
+import { convert } from './src/main/importers/importers/curl';
+
+describe('curl UA', () => {
+  it('injects UA when absent', async () => {
+    settingsMock.getOrCreate.mockResolvedValue({ disableAppVersionUserAgent: false });
+    const r = await convert('curl https://example.com') as any[];
+    expect(r[0].headers).toContainEqual({ name: 'User-Agent', value: 'insomnia/9.9.9' });
+  });
+  it('preserves explicit UA', async () => {
+    settingsMock.getOrCreate.mockResolvedValue({ disableAppVersionUserAgent: false });
+    const r = await convert("curl https://example.com -H 'user-agent: custom'") as any[];
+    const uas = r[0].headers.filter((h: any) => h.name.toLowerCase() === 'user-agent');
+    expect(uas).toEqual([{ name: 'user-agent', value: 'custom' }]);
+  });
+  it('skips when disabled', async () => {
+    settingsMock.getOrCreate.mockResolvedValue({ disableAppVersionUserAgent: true });
+    const r = await convert('curl https://example.com') as any[];
+    expect(r[0].headers.some((h: any) => h.name.toLowerCase() === 'user-agent')).toBe(false);
+  });
+  it('preserves explicit UA even when disabled', async () => {
+    settingsMock.getOrCreate.mockResolvedValue({ disableAppVersionUserAgent: true });
+    const r = await convert("curl https://example.com -H 'User-Agent: custom'") as any[];
+    expect(r[0].headers).toContainEqual({ name: 'User-Agent', value: 'custom' });
+  });
+});
